content: Spectrum Health is a comprehensive network of healthcare facilities that includes hospitals, treatment centers, urgent care facilities, and physician practices. These facilities serve the Western Michigan region. Spectrum Health is recognized as one of the Top 50 Integrated Health Care Networks in the United States. The hospitals within Spectrum Health include the following: Blodgett Campus: Located in East Grand Rapids, Michigan, this facility provides a range of medical services. Butterworth Campus: Situated in downtown Grand Rapids, Michigan, this hospital offers advanced medical care. Helen DeVos Children’s Hospital: Also located in downtown Grand Rapids, Michigan, this hospital specializes in pediatric care. Kent Community Campus: Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, this facility focuses on long-term care services. Reed City Campus: Located in Reed City, Michigan, this hospital serves the surrounding community with various healthcare services. In addition to these hospitals, Spectrum Health has a network of hundreds of primary care physicians who are experts in their respective specialties, ensuring comprehensive and specialized care for patients. Spectrum Health also operates an air ambulance helicopter service known as AeroMed. This service is designed to transport patients from accident scenes, between hospitals, and to and from the airport, providing critical and timely medical transportation.
